purpose: Track recovery and durable custody of recent TYME Hall work while ChatGPT Space/Page projections are unstable or blank.

observations.observation: The connected ChatGPT Space backend returned zero accessible Drive-backed Spaces during this recovery pass.
observations.interpretation: The blank or Untitled Page entries visible in the client could not be inspected or repaired through the available Space connector in this session.
observations.limitation: This does not prove the underlying Pages were deleted; it establishes only that they were not backend-accessible through the connector used here.

observations.observation: The public Hall source repository remains accessible and contains the existing foyer, Office, Laboratory, Scrolls, Contribution and related static surfaces.
Recent generated artifacts remain discoverable in the file library even where Page projections are unreliable.

rule: Repository-backed artifacts are the durable public anchor. Space/Page surfaces may project or summarize them but should not be the sole custody layer.
